payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all CPUs; for each working CPU, applies a constant-time pattern-based check on immediate neighbors to determine if it is critical (articulation point) in the 3D directed grid.
payload.rationale: Solution uses local pattern checks instead of graph traversal, but the underlying problem is about graph connectivity; assigned the closest subtype search_dfs_bfs_graph as it relates to graph reachability.
